newsitem.title: UK: BZW sees operating profit fall 29 pct.
newsitem.headline: BZW sees operating profit fall 29 pct.

text.p: Barclays Plc said on Tuesday its investment banking unit BZW had an operating profit of 204 million stg in 1996, 29 percent lower than the 289 million stg recorded in 1995.
There had been rumours and press reports of an even bigger fall in the unit's profit with one newspaper predicting a slump to 190 million stg.
Barclays said BZW's results were affected by underperformance in both fixed income, apart from sterling, and foreign exchange trading which "performed poorly in an increasingly competitive market."
It said income rose by seven percent but costs were 18 percent higher year-on-year and rose more steeply in the second half during which a new senior management team was put in place.
Barclays said more investment in people and technology would continue to affect BZW's results in the short term. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717.
